lgmc-methodology.text: How was this calculated? Repayment mortgage: monthly payment = L × r ÷ (1 − (1 + r)^−n), where L is £280,000 borrowed, r is the monthly interest rate (annual nominal rate ÷ 12), and n is 300 monthly payments. Total interest = sum of monthly payments − original borrowing. This assumes a constant rate and excludes fees and other charges.Interest rates may change during the mortgage term. Interest-only mortgages require a separate plan to repay the outstanding capital.
